name: Kuala Terengganu Service Centre
developer: CSF Group / CSF Advisers (now Digital Realty)
notes: Baxtel lists the Kuala Terengganu Service Centre at Lot PT 28521-A as fully operational and operated by CSF Group; CSF's own site confirms the group is a carrier-neutral data centre provider now branded as Digital Realty. No public MW capacity found.

name: Poseidon Sabah / Aeropod Tier IV-quality data centre
developer: Poseidon Technologies Sdn Bhd with Permodalan RISDA Berhad
notes: 2023 reports described an RM119 million Tier IV-quality facility at Aeropod near Kota Kinabalu, expected then by July 2024. Baxtel later lists the project as planned for 2028. A July 9, 2025 Daily Express report quotes Sabah's Industrial Development and Entrepreneurship Minister saying Sabah is not ready for data centre investments due to water and electricity limits, so status remains planned rather than construction/operational.

name: Sabah Net Data Centre
notes: Sabah Net's official services page lists a Sabah Net Data Centre designed to support enterprise applications, databases, big data, AI and machine-learning workloads. No public MW capacity found.

name: irix Kuching 1 DC @ Santubong
notes: Official irix pages describe Kuching 1 DC @ Santubong as a carrier-neutral green data centre in Kuching, alongside irix's cable landing station, and report Uptime Institute Tier IV Certification of Constructed Facility. Baxtel lists detailed site metrics including 0.3 MW for one data hall, but total public capacity is not consistently stated.

name: FutureData Park first Global Telecommunications data centre
developer: FutureData Sdn Bhd consortium (TSG Group and Cyclect) / Global Telecommunications Group
notes: FutureData's Sarawak park was announced as a renewable-energy data centre park in Kota Samarahan/Kuching. Data Center Dynamics reports the first Global Telecommunications facility will have 17 MW IT capacity, cost about US$130 million, start construction in Q2 2025 and target operation in 2026; public sources do not yet confirm completion.

name: FutureData renewable-energy data centre park
developer: FutureData Sdn Bhd consortium (TSG Group and Cyclect)
notes: DCD describes FutureData as a planned 500 MW Malaysian data center park in Sarawak, formed by TSG Group and Cyclect, with build-to-suit facilities. TSG's project page calls it the first and largest renewable energy Data Center Park in Sarawak, with 135 acres earmarked for data centers.

name: Kota Petra Green Technology Park AI data centres
developer: Zecon Berhad with SDEC and CENTEXS
notes: Zecon's official project page says KPGTP is planned with six sites for AI-driven data centres, powered by a 300 MW large-scale solar farm and 600 MWh BESS. The 300 MW figure is generation infrastructure rather than disclosed IT load, so capacity_mw is null.

name: SDEC-Huawei FusionDC-1000 modular hybrid data centre initiative
developer: Sarawak Digital Economy Corporation (SDEC) and Huawei
notes: Huawei social/video material describes SDEC and Huawei launching East Malaysia/Sarawak's first modular, hybrid-powered data center initiative using FusionDC-1000. Public technical capacity and exact site status were not found; SDEC's Huawei Cloud case confirms SDEC operates SDeCLOUD for Sarawak digital services.

name: AIMS Menara AIMS (KL1)
notes: AIMS' official points-of-presence page lists its Kuala Lumpur Menara as a purpose-built Tier III data centre; DigitalBridge describes Menara AIMS as AIMS' flagship facility, hosting MyIX and serving as Malaysia's principal carrier hotel. AIMS page references 10 MVA and scalable power up to 30 MW for the Kuala Lumpur Menara location, but clear IT-load MW was not found.

name: Bangunan AIMS / AIMS KL2
notes: AIMS announced Bangunan AIMS (KL2) as a 7.5 MW IT-load ecosystem data centre adjacent to Menara AIMS (KL1) in the heart of Kuala Lumpur, targeting carrier-neutral central business district demand and offering 100% infrastructure uptime guarantee.

name: TM ONE Brickfields City Data Centre
notes: TM ONE and TM Global official pages describe active Malaysian data centre/colocation services. Data Center Journal lists TM ONE Brickfields City DC in Kuala Lumpur operated by Telekom Malaysia. No public MW capacity found.

name: VADS Semarak Data Center
notes: Data Center Map lists VADS Semarak at Level 19, Menara Celcom, Jalan Semarak, Kuala Lumpur. VADS is part of Telekom Malaysia/TM ONE, whose official pages describe active data centre services. No public MW capacity found.

name: Microsoft Malaysia West cloud region
notes: Microsoft announced general availability of Malaysia West, its first Malaysian cloud region, on May 28, 2025. Microsoft Local says it is building datacenters near Kuala Lumpur; public sources describe three availability zones but do not disclose MW capacity or exact site addresses.

name: Equinix KL1 Kuala Lumpur / Cyberjaya IBX
notes: Equinix's official KL1 page places KL1 in Cyberjaya under its Kuala Lumpur data center market, with the facility operating by 2024 according to Equinix newsroom. Data Center Map reports 4.8 MW. Note: Cyberjaya is in Selangor/Greater Kuala Lumpur rather than physically inside the Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur.

name: NEXTDC KL1 Kuala Lumpur Data Centre
notes: NEXTDC announced KL1 Kuala Lumpur opened for business on May 14, 2026. Its official facility page describes KL1 as located in Petaling Jaya and delivering 65 MW of IT capacity. Note: Petaling Jaya is in Selangor/Greater Kuala Lumpur rather than physically inside the Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur.

name: VADS Labuan
notes: Data Center Map lists one Labuan facility, VADS Labuan, at Level 2, Ibusawat Telekom Kg. Jawa, 87000 WP Labuan, described as VADS Managed Data Centre Services. TM ONE official pages confirm Telekom Malaysia's data centre service line; no public MW capacity found.
